title: Windows Bootstrap Integration

bootstrap_changes.original_behavior: Started only backend (uvicorn on port 8000), MediaMTX manual
bootstrap_changes.new_behavior: Starts both backend (port 8000) and Figma frontend (port 8443) in background
bootstrap_changes.process_management: Uses 'start /B' for background processes with named window titles
bootstrap_changes.cleanup: taskkill on exit to stop both services

startup_sequence: 3. Validate core dependencies (FastAPI, ONNX Runtime, OpenCV)
10. Start Figma frontend (pnpm dev) in background

frontend_detection.npm_fallback: Falls back to 'where npm' if pnpm not found

known_issues: Background processes may not clean up properly on forced termination
No health check before showing 'Services Started' message
Frontend build not verified before starting dev server
No log aggregation for background processes
